meta.name: business-intelligence
meta.description: Builds reporting and self-serve analytics that people actually use — metric trees, dashboard design, distribution, and the discipline that stops dashboards proliferating. Use this to build a dashboard or report, design a metrics framework, set up self-serve analytics, decide what to measure, or diagnose why reporting exists but nobody uses it or trusts it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建实用的报表看板，让数据自己讲故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队数据没人用，报表总是做出来就荒废
copy.tagline_en: Build dashboards and reports that people actually use
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team ignores the reports and dashboards get abandoned

howto.what: 做报表或指标框架时,它会先问报告要支持什么决策;把指标按“核心指标→驱动因素”拆成树状;仪表盘要求一屏一问题、带比较基准、标注异常;自助分析给受治理指标和模板;并建议定期清理没人用的报告。
howto.when: 当你说要建仪表盘或报表、设计指标框架等,或提到报表没人用、没人信时触发。

say.text: 帮我把收入指标拆成指标树,从核心指标往下分解成驱动因素。
say.note: 它会按决策→核心指标→驱动因素的顺序拆解。

say.text: 我要做一张销售周报仪表盘,先告诉我它该回答什么问题。
say.note: 它会要求你明确读者和行动,再开始设计。

say.text: 现有报表没人看也没人信,帮我诊断一下。
say.note: 它会检查缺少决策关联、比较和信任机制的地方。

howto.what_en: For reports, it asks what decision they support; structures metrics as a tree; requires one question per screen, comparisons, and anomaly notes; self-serve uses governed metrics; suggests removing unused dashboards.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a dashboard or report, design a metrics framework, set up self-serve analytics, or mention reports nobody uses or trusts.

say_en.text: Help me break revenue into a metric tree, decomposing the core metric into drivers.
say_en.note: It breaks down by decision → core metric → drivers.

say_en.text: I want a weekly sales dashboard — first tell me what question it should answer.
say_en.note: It asks you to clarify audience and action before designing.

say_en.text: Our reports are unused and untrusted; help me diagnose why.
